findings.message: Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$method" was used, and possibly changed (by reference), on line 42. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this behaviour, so the upgrade changes nothing)

'enum' is a soft reserved keyword as of PHP version 8.1 and should not be used to name a class, interface, trait or enum or as part of a namespace (class declaration) (since PHP 8.1 enum is a keyword only when another name follows it, so a class named Enum (class Enum extends X) stays valid PHP)
